actions.description: See every engagement request in the list and its details
Raise an engagement request, and read the CRM accounts, opportunities and products it is built from
Edit an engagement and refresh its dates from the CRM
Set an engagement's status, including cancelling it, and complete or reopen its request

permissions.description: The approval queue for internal engagements and marketing events

actions.description: See every engagement or event waiting for approval
Correct a pending engagement or event
Approve a pending engagement or event; final
See every engagement allocation and the consultants' timelines
Allocate a staff or partner consultant to an engagement
Change an allocation's clearance status or comment
Read the skills register, get suggested skills and search for consultants by skill

permissions.description: Team default allocations, those that belong to no engagement

actions.description: See the default allocations of any team
Add, change, remove or bulk upload default allocations
See the allocation charts for any business unit
Run the consultant allocations report for anyone

permissions.description: The allocation types that classify engagements and allocations

actions.description: Add, change or delete an allocation type
See every partner consultant, left ones included
Add, change or delete a partner consultant

permissions.description: The app's access roles and their privileges

actions.description: See the roles and privileges, change a role's privileges and add a role

roles.name: Requester
roles.description: Raises customer and internal engagement requests, edits them, and completes, reopens or cancels them. Does not approve, allocate consultants or see reports.

roles.name: Approver
roles.description: Approves pending internal engagements and marketing events, correcting them first when needed. Sees nothing but the approval queue.

roles.name: AllocationManager
roles.description: Allocates staff and partner consultants to engagements and takes each allocation through clearance. Cannot raise or edit engagements or change team default allocations.

roles.name: TeamManager
roles.description: Keeps the default allocations of a team current, one at a time or by CSV upload. Never touches engagement allocations.

roles.name: FinanceAnalyst
roles.description: Reads the allocation dashboard and runs the consultant allocations report. Read only; changes nothing.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Maintains allocation types, partner consultants and the privileges of access roles. Does not raise, approve or allocate.
